## Change and reason

Explain the user-visible problem and the smallest relevant change.

## Validation

State exactly what was built/tested, the compiler and relevant game reference.
Separate tooling/isolated-native checks from actual in-game observations.

- [ ] Native action, hold timing and UI behavior are preserved, or an intentional change is explained.
- [ ] No game binary, raw disassembly, private diagnostic capture, save or secret is included.
- [ ] Build/packaging checks pass; appropriate regressions and documentation are included.
- [ ] No network/telemetry/configuration dependency is introduced without discussion.
